evidence.title: Scene 7, 慈云普护 Ciyun Puhu, Island of Shrines
evidence.excerpt_other: A three-storied bell tower with a sun dial on its south front, and shrines to Buddha, to the God of War, and to the Dragon King were grouped around a cove on the west side of this small island.
evidence.summary: Three-storey bell tower with a sundial on the south front and shrines to Buddha, the God of War and the Dragon King, round a cove on the west side.

evidence.title: 释圆明园慈云普护之多神殿
evidence.summary: 慈云普护 Ciyun Puhu, north shore of 后湖, 120 x 90 m, 800 m2 of buildings. A temple garden for several faiths: 欢喜佛场 for Buddha, a tower with 观音 above and 关帝 below, and the 龙王殿 for 昭福龙王. Cites a 1794 repair list giving three bays with a three-bay rear annex for 欢喜佛场.
